configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: Matches this project's default CMake option values exactly -- no FEMFX, no GPU profiler (Jolt and Lua are on). The smallest, fastest build; only kke_demo/imgui_demo/rmlui_demo and the test suite.

configurePresets.name: everything
configurePresets.description: Every optional piece this engine has, on at once: FEMFX physics, GPU profiling, and Lua scripting. This is what most people actively developing the engine itself want -- see docs/BUILDING.md for the system packages this needs first.

configurePresets.name: everything-release
configurePresets.description: Same as 'everything', but RelWithDebInfo (optimized, still has symbols) in its own build-release/ directory. Use this to judge performance -- the Debug build compiles engine code at -O0, which is fine for stepping through code but not representative of what a player would see. FEMFX itself is always optimized either way (see external/FEMFX/CMakeLists.txt).

configurePresets.name: steam-deck
configurePresets.description: Release build tuned for the Steam Deck's Zen 2 CPU (-march=znver2, also fine on any Zen 2 or newer PC) that starts on the steam-deck hardware target (docs/PLATFORMS.md). Runs on SteamOS as a normal Linux build.

configurePresets.name: handheld-pc
configurePresets.description: Release build for ROG Ally / Legion Go / MSI Claw class handhelds (x86-64-v3: AVX2, any 2015+ CPU), starting on the handheld-pc hardware target (docs/PLATFORMS.md).

configurePresets.name: low-end-pc
configurePresets.description: Release build for old or weak PCs: baseline x86-64 (no AVX needed), FEMFX off, starting on the desktop-low hardware target (docs/PLATFORMS.md).

configurePresets.name: android-arm64
configurePresets.description: Native arm64 libraries for Android 9+ with the NDK in $ANDROID_NDK_HOME (or use 'docker compose run --rm android'). FEMFX stays off until its ARM port (docs/SCALING.md); the android target is picked at runtime.
